name: Cut In Wall at Ceiling Line
intent: Wall painter establishes the wall-to-ceiling line freehand with a brush. Per doctrine, this edge is never taped — the wall painter cuts to the ceiling on every coat. This module fires once per coat. Coat 2 is meaningfully slower than coat 1 because the painter is correcting any wandering from the first pass.
doctrine: Freehand cut-in is the wall painter's most skill-intensive task. Rate slows ~25% on coat 2 because the painter is fixing inconsistencies from coat 1, not because the work is harder. QT modifier slows the rate further at QT4/QT5 where the line must be dead straight under critical inspection. Height modifier applies because tall walls require ladder cut-in which is inherently slower than ground-level.
